test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The sweater is knitted by Suman.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Suman knits the sweater**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in **passive voice**, indicating that the action (**knitting**) is being done by someone (**Suman**) to something (**the sweater**).
 
• To convert a sentence from **passive **to **active **voice, the **subject **(doer of the action) should be placed **before the verb**, followed by the **object **(receiver of the action).
 
• The correct verb form must be used to match the tense and aspect indicated in the original sentence.
 
 
• In this case, the present simple tense "**knits**" is appropriate, conveying a general or habitual action.
 
 
 
• The structure of an active voice sentence typically follows the format: **Subject + Verb + Object**.
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is '**Suman knits the sweater**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) Suman be knitted the sweater**. This option is grammatically incorrect and does not correctly convert the sentence to active voice.
 
• **Option 3) Suman have knitting the sweater**. This option misuses the verb form and fails to correctly structure the sentence in active voice.
 
• **Option 4) Suman been knit the sweater**. This option is grammatically incorrect and does not follow the correct format for an active voice sentence.
